question: What is the penalty if I submit my coursework late?
gold_answer: A standard 30% deduction from the mark, for work submitted up to five working days late.

question: If I hand in coursework 7 working days late, will it still be marked?
gold_answer: No. Work submitted more than five working days late gets 0 F with no feedback, unless mitigating circumstances are approved.

question: Can I ask my lecturer for an extension on an assignment?
gold_answer: No individual extensions are permitted (exceptions: reasonable adjustments considered case by case, and Course Leaders may extend for a whole class in exceptional circumstances).

question: Does the late penalty apply to class tests and presentations?
gold_answer: No. Time-limited work such as class tests and presentations is exempt from the late submission policy; work submitted after the allocated time is not marked (0 F).

question: Can a course leader give the whole class more time for coursework?
gold_answer: Yes, Course Leaders may give an extension to an entire class in exceptional circumstances.

question: How long do I have to send missing documents for a mitigating circumstances application?
gold_answer: Ten working days; otherwise the application is closed.

question: For how long can I self-certify mitigating circumstances?
gold_answer: The self-certified MC period must be no more than seven days.

question: What outcomes can a successful mitigating circumstances application lead to?
gold_answer: Mitigations include removing the late penalty, resit as same opportunity, disregarding a component, mapping a grade, or presenting to the progression/award board.

question: Will a mitigating circumstances claim be accepted without any evidence?
gold_answer: No. Applications with no or insufficient evidence are not accepted (a self-certification form may be used for short periods).

question: What grade do I need to pass a core course?
gold_answer: Grade D is the minimum to pass core courses.
gold_quote: minimum requirement to pass core courses

question: What is the lowest grade that still gives me credit points?
gold_answer: Grade E is the minimum for gaining credit points.

question: How many times can I resit a course I failed?
gold_answer: One re-assessment opportunity per course, normally at the next diet (usually August).

question: Do I get any credits for an F grade?
gold_answer: No, Grade F does not carry any credits.

question: How much is the tuition fee per semester for international Computing Science students in 2026/27?
gold_answer: RM25,960 per semester (RM51,920 a year), plus 6% SST for non-Malaysian students (RM27,517.60 per semester including SST).

question: Do international students pay service tax on their fees?
gold_answer: Yes, a 6% service tax (SST) is charged to non-Malaysian students.

question: How much is the registration fee for international students?
gold_answer: RM500 + 6% SST = RM530, non-refundable.

question: When do I have to pay my semester fees?
gold_answer: In advance: semester fees must be fully paid before the start of the semester.

question: Can I pay my tuition fees in instalments?
gold_answer: Yes, a 6-month 0% instalment plan with a Maybank credit card, minimum RM15,000, with an RM200 administration fee.

question: How do I pay my fees online?
